one_liner_zh: Uber本季EPS低於預期9.6%，恐受投資評價或一次性項目影響獲利。
one_liner_en: Uber missed EPS by 9.6% this quarter, likely on investment marks or one-off items affecting earnings.
ai_view_zh: 訊號偏中性：EPS不及預期9.6%，對Uber而言常與股權投資公允價值評價或一次性項目相關，未必反映核心營運惡化，須拆解調整後EBITDA與總訂單金額才能判斷。短期股價或因帳面數字承壓，市場聚焦核心獲利與自由現金流。中期關鍵在規模效應與自駕策略。追蹤指標：總訂單金額年增、各業務調整後EBITDA、股權投資損益拆解、月活躍消費者，以及自由現金流與全年指引。
ai_view_en: Signal is roughly neutral: a 9.6% EPS miss, for Uber, is often tied to equity-investment fair-value marks or one-off items rather than core deterioration, so adjusted EBITDA and gross bookings are needed to judge. Near-term the stock may face pressure from the headline figure as the market focuses on core earnings and free cash flow. Mid-term, scale effects and autonomous strategy are key. Track: gross bookings growth, segment adjusted EBITDA, equity-investment gains/losses bridge, monthly active consumers, and free cash flow plus full-year guidance.
highlights_zh: EPS 0.71美元，低於預期0.79美元，負向驚喜9.60%
營收143.7億美元，反映旺季較大規模
出行與外送平台訂單動能維持成長
廣告與會員業務持續提升變現能力
highlights_en: EPS of $0.71 missed the $0.79 estimate, a 9.60% negative surprise
Revenue of $14.37B reflects a larger peak-season base
Mobility and delivery bookings momentum continues to grow
Advertising and membership keep improving monetization
risks_zh: EPS不及預期可能受股權投資評價或一次性項目拖累
營收年增資料缺失，成長趨勢判讀受限
監管與司機成本及總體消費風險
risks_en: The EPS miss may stem from equity-investment marks or one-off items
Missing revenue YoY limits the read on growth trends
Regulatory, driver-cost, and macro consumption risks
